notes.subject: परान
notes.rationale: נפש here is the breathing life-force, the enemies' cry „our desire is met”, not a disembodied soul

notes.subject: האח נפשנו
notes.rationale: „Aha, our desire!” (KJV/JPS) versus a reading as swallowing: „Aha, we have devoured him” — the parallel with בלענוהו pulls both ways

notes.subject: אמר...אמר
notes.rationale: repetition of „say” in both halves frames the enemies' gloating speech, kept by repeating कहऽ होवे

translation: ऊकनी मत कहऽ होवे अपन हिरदय में: „हे! हमर परान निचोड़ल” — ऊकनी मत कहऽ होवे: „हम ⟨את⟩ ओकरा निगल गेलिए”।
